stable.release_notes: AgentNEO v3.0.21 introduces task-scoped ChatGPT-style isolation routing: ordinary chat and read-only diagnostics do not open Windows Sandbox; generated/untrusted execution and required file-processing use ephemeral isolated workspaces with offline-by-default networking, hard user constraints and no silent host fallback. The cumulative updater is validated for direct upgrades from v3.0.11 through v3.0.20.
